limitations.note: The agent fixed the read timing but also made out-of-range reads return zero, whereas the original and reference implementations leave those reads unknown in simulation.
The test checked the main timing fix, but its out-of-range case asserted the newly chosen zero result rather than detecting the change from the original behavior.
